description: Pipesys adds pipeline hydraulics to HYSYS, UniSim and Petro-SIM. It models multiphase production and transport flows using fluid descriptions from the host process simulator, including equipment and heat-transfer calculations. The provider is SLB. Coverage: The module supports user-defined pipelines and networks. Coverage, operating periods and spatial discretisation depend on the host model. Access: The provider page documents supported hosts and functions. No module or host software was downloaded. Licence and cost: The provider offers a product contact route. The module and host simulator may require separate commercial entitlements. Limitations: The provider explicitly distinguishes Pipesys from PIPESIM, whose models are built externally. Their names do not establish a duplicate product. For simulation it links process-facility and pipeline calculations within a common model environment. Related resources: PIPESIM is separately prepared as P00380 in this batch. It is not an existing catalogue reference and is not treated as a covering parent.
